title: Infinity Dragon Lighthouse
description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts two intertwined orange dragons forming an infinity symbol in the night sky. At the center is a glowing lighthouse emerging from a purple vortex, with a green dog standing at its base on a small island. A blue wizard on a crescent moon shoots lightning while a red witch rides the dragon holding a smiley-face staff.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene with two ornate orange dragons intertwined in an infinity loop across the sky, a glowing green and white striped lighthouse rising from a swirling purple vortex portal with lightning, a happy green dog standing beside it on a small reflective island with flowers and dead trees, black cats on branches, a blue wizard on a smiling crescent moon casting lightning, a red witch riding one dragon holding a smiley face staff, colorful hot air balloons floating, dramatic clouds and stars, vibrant colors, detailed fantasy illustration
